changeSet.author: abhijith
changeSet.comment: Four policy rules the leave module did not let an organization state (#838). Each default is the behaviour every existing policy already had, so no row changes meaning: accrual_method MONTHLY is the one-twelfth-a-month credit the accrual has always made; weekend_holiday_treatment CHARGE_ALL_DAYS is the end-to-end calendar count every request was charged; approver_role REPORTING_MANAGER is the management line the approval chain has always walked. supporting_document_note is free text beside the existing requires_attachment flag, so it is nullable with no default.
